thread:
leo: deploy-bot flagged a canary p95 regression (~+23%) on /embeddings during the v2.9 rollout in us-west. Its recommending auto-revert. Need a quick decision: let it run or do a manual surgical pin?
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary p95 +23% vs baseline. Auto-revert threshold breached. Suggested action: AUTO-ROLLBACK. [telemetry link]
sophia: Oncall here. Any 5xxs or customer tickets?
leo: No 5xxs, two CS mentions but not widespread. Latency and KVcache miss up after the new kernel optimizations.
mara: Full revert is noisy. Can we carve embeddings traffic back to the previous binary for a smaller slice and observe? That should suppress auto-revert if we act fast.
oncall-bot: POLICY: Partial routing pins during change windows require oncall + release-owner approval. Manual intervention will suppress auto-revert. Please acknowledge.
sophia: I approve a manual partial pin. Release-owner, you good?
release-owner: Approve manual partial pin for embeddings. Keep scope <= 30% initially and monitor 2x p95 windows.
leo: Executing now: ```rwctl route pin --service=embeddings --version=1.6.2 --scope=25% --ramp=60s --reason=canary_p95_spike```
leo: Pin applied, ramping 25% slice in 60s. Monitoring p95 and KVcache metrics.
deploy-bot: ACTION: routing policy updated: embeddings -> 1.6.2 (slice 25%). Auto-revert suppressed while manual mitigation active.
mara: Pinned slice p95 dropped ~18% within 90s; KVcache miss for pinned slice normalized. Unpinned traffic still elevated.
sophia: Good signal. Ramp to 100% if pinned slice holds for 2 windows, otherwise prepare full revert.
leo: Ramping to 100% now over 3m per runbook.
leo: Ramp complete; overall p95 back near baseline and no spike in 5xx.
release-owner: Great. Mira (docs) please add a short note: rolled back embeddings routing to prior binary (v1.6.2) and paused rollout; no broad user impact. Add RCA next steps.
mara: Draft: "During a staged rollout we observed increased latency for embeddings. We pinned embeddings routing to the previous stable binary (v1.6.2) and paused further rollout. No customer-facing errors were reported. Engineering will investigate a kernel/cache interaction and run targeted perf tests in staging"
sophia: Looks good. Posting to #release-notes and notifying CS. Closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: RECORD: manual partial rollback executed; approved by oncall and release-owner. Incident state: mitigated."
